problem: Engineering leaders lack data on developer productivity and delivery.

founders.name: Alex Circei
founders.background_notes: Started first company in Romania at 21 per YC page; applied to YC 13 times.

competitors.name: GitPrime / Pluralsight Flow
competitors.traction_then: Acquired by Pluralsight in 2019 per a secondary roundup

technical_complexity.rationale: Git and tracker integrations with metrics.

defensibility.rationale: Many comparable tools; differentiation on price and depth.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Competitors grew and Flow was sold to Appfire in 2025.

market_need_then: Rise of remote engineering teams and DORA metrics.

pivots.why: AI adoption and ROI tracking demand per company site

outcome_analysis: Waydev was incorporated in March 2017, bootstrapped to profitability before YC W21, and sells to enterprises such as American Express and Caterpillar per its own pages. Public funding is only small YC money in aggregators. It has retooled for AI adoption analytics and remains active.
notes: Funding unverified (aggregators say $120K to $130K seed from YC and others, 2020-12 or 2021-03). Competitor date reflects the 2019 acquisition fact from an undated competitor article. Customer claims are vendor stated.
